$comment: Independent blind AI cross-check of human labels. Not ground truth and not a replacement for them: the human answers in data/prevalence.json are unchanged. AI labelled all 150 descriptions before reading any human answer (blind answers committed in 8270be4 before this comparison).

weighting.note: Allocation was proportional to stratum size, so the sample is self-weighting; weighted share differs from the raw share only by largest-remainder rounding.
